description:
FINALY ALMOST DONE!
Before starting, make the setup script executable and run it:
```bash
chmod +x scripts/setup.sh
./scripts/setup.sh
```
This script removes any existing Git history so you can start fresh.

---
## git init
`git init` creates a new Git repository in your current directory. A repository (or `repo`) is just one project. You should have 1 repo per project you work on.
This allows Git to start tracking changes in your project.

---
## Assignment
Navigate to the project files, initialize the git repository, and submit your work from the project root directory.
